resources.string: Choose a server or import a configuration file to connect.
Optional. A provider gives you access to its servers. It cannot change your identity, contacts or privacy settings.

Browser enrollment requires an explicit application registration.

To change servers, remove this provider and sign in again.
Remove local access for %1$s, even when offline. This stops its active connection. Account deletion and remote revocation are separate.
This provider grants access only to its infrastructure. Browser sign-in uses the issuer you accept here.
I accept this provider and issuer.
Sign in to get a server

Opens %1$s in your browser. Your password stays there.
Access ends at %1$s. Choose this server again to renew it.
Access ended. Choose this server again to renew it.
Connects to %1$s:%2$d. This is the server address, not proof of where traffic leaves.
Your account does not include this server.
The provider is unavailable. Try again later.
The server list is out of date or this phone\'s time could not be confirmed. Check the date and time, then try again.
